title: pyrus × magdeburgensis
intro: Pyrus × magdeburgensis, commonly known as the Magdeburg pear, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × magdeburgensis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
